::: {.ctm-hero}

**FOR STUDENTS**

# Learn mathematics through code.

Discover how programming and computational
thinking can help you explore mathematical
concepts, solve problems, and develop
new ways of thinking.

Whether you're completely new to programming
or looking to develop your skills, CTM aims
to make computational mathematics more accessible.

:::


::::: {.ctm-section}

## Explore Learning Materials

CTM aims to support your learning through
three types of educational resources.

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

::: {.ctm-card}

### Tutorials

Learn programming step by step,
using mathematical examples to
develop your understanding.

:::

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

::: {.ctm-card}

### Exercises

Practice computational thinking
through mathematical problems
and programming activities.

:::

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}

::: {.ctm-card}

### Projects

Apply programming and mathematical
reasoning to more substantial problems
and practical applications.

:::

:::

## What Is Computational Thinking?

Computational thinking is about more
than simply writing code.

It includes:

- Breaking down complex problems
- Recognizing patterns
- Developing algorithms
- Testing and evaluating solutions
- Connecting computational results
  to mathematical understanding

These skills can help you approach
mathematical problems in new ways.

:::


::: {.ctm-section .ctm-section-light}

## Interested in the Project?

CTM is a collaboration between European
universities working to make programming
and computational thinking more accessible
in mathematics education.

[Learn more about CTM](about.qmd){.ctm-button-outline}
